I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

Boundaries for the allotments of land depicted as below mentionednames and extents in the Advance Tracing No. CO/MRT/2012/1016dated 17.06.2015, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in theVillage of Katubedda (within the limits of Moratuwa Urban Council)in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Moratuwa in ColomboDistrict, Western Province:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Assmt. No. 93, P. B. Alwis Perera Mawatha(Portion) – Extent: 0.0012 HectareNorth: Land bearing the Assmt. No. 27 at Mihiri Place; East:Gutter; South: Land bearing the Assmt. Nos. 93 and 89 at P. B. AlwisPerera Mawatha; West: Lot B and Land bearing the Assmt. No. 27 atMihiri Place.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Assmt. No. 89, P. B. Alwis Perera Mawatha(Portion) – Extent: 0.0006 HectareNorth: Land bearing the Assmt. No. 27 at Mihiri Place; East:Lot A and Land bearing the Assmt. Nos. 93 and 89 at P. B. Alwis
Perera Mawatha; South: Land bearing the Assmt. Nos. 89 and 85 atP. B. Alwis Perera Mawatha; West: Lot C, Mihiri Place and Landbearing the Assmt. No. 27 at Mihiri Place.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Assmt. No. 85, P. B. Alwis Perera Mawatha(Portion) – Extent: 0.0001 HectareNorth: Mihiri Place and Land bearing the Assmt. No. 27 at MihiriPlace; East: Lot B and Land bearing the Assmt.
